verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents the speech-to-text API and names model generations such as 'Scribe v2', but nothing describes API versioning or a deprecation policy. Model version names are an adjacent feature, not a versioned-API contract with documented deprecation terms. The axis applies to an API product, so lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
